summary: Data + simulation layer in place. Islamabad geo fixture covers 31 sectors with vulnerability index. 60-asset resource roster across 9 capability types. All 6 signal streams populated. Replay engine validates and dry-runs scenario A.

Vulnerability index computed up-front avoids recomputation in every round.
